description.value: The Hyatt Regency Vancouver is a large full-service luxury hotel in the heart of downtown Vancouver, steps from Burrard SkyTrain Station and a short ride from the Stanley Park seawall. As a flagship Regency-brand property, it offers the amenity depth typical of major urban convention hotels. Touring cyclists finishing or starting a BC coastal route will find it well-positioned for access to the city's extensive waterfront cycling network.
